description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'TodoTile' that displays a to-do item with features such as marking complete, editing, and deleting via swipe gestures. It is part of a to-do list application frontend, managing the visual representation and user interactions of individual to-do entries.

classes.name: TodoTile
classes.description: A stateless widget that visually represents a single to-do item, providing interactive controls for toggling completion, editing, and deletion.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the to-do tile, including dismissible actions, list tile display, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: _slideLeftBackground
methods.description: Returns a widget showing the background when the tile is swiped right to left for editing.

methods.name: _slideRightBackground
methods.description: Returns a widget showing the background when the tile is swiped left to right for deletion.
